title: Wire sub-agents to read AI model config from MySQL secrets instead of hardcoding
body:
## Objective
Sub-agents (CTO, Worker, Reviewer) currently use whatever model their host environment provides by default. They should read model configuration from the MySQL secrets table at runtime.

## Implementation
The Admin → Integrations page stores AI model settings in MySQL secrets table:

| Key | Example |
|-----|---------|
| ai_model_provider | google |
| ai_model_name | gemini-2.5-flash |
| ai_api_endpoint | https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/ |
| ai_api_key | (encrypted) |

The SecretService class already exists at app/Services/SecretService.php. It needs:
1. Method to read AI model config: getModelConfig(): array
2. CLI command or env var override for agents: BAPX_AI_MODEL, BAPX_AI_API_KEY, BAPX_AI_ENDPOINT
3. Fallback chain: SecretService → env var → hardcoded default (gemini-2.5-flash)

## Files
- app/Services/SecretService.php — add getModelConfig()
- cli/bapXphp — add ai:config command to display current model settings
- .github/workflows/*.yml — pass AI model config as env vars if needed

## Acceptance
- bapXphp ai:config shows the configured model and endpoint
- SecretService::getModelConfig() returns values from MySQL with env fallback
- All agent tooling can read model from configured source
